title: Long time behavior of small solutions of NLS with non-generic potentials in one dimension
summary: We consider the one-dimensional cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation with a non-generic real-valued external potential $V$. We prove almost global-in-time quantitative bounds for small solutions. More precisely, small initial data of size $\varepsilon$ in a weighted Sobolev space give rise to solutions with the sharp decay rate $t^{-1/2}$ in $L^{\infty}_x$ up to time $\exp(\frac{1}{c\varepsilon^{2}})$.
